description: Price a basket of products for a monthly subscription: line totals, subtotal, VAT and total in ILS. Returns online_checkout_url when the basket can be bought online (one SentinelOne plan plus supported add-ons), otherwise a quote request URL. Does not buy anything. Shows an interactive quote with a checkout button where the host supports MCP Apps.

quantity.description: Endpoints, users or servers, depending on the product unit. Ignored for monthly flat-price items.
